raw.title: Denali Therapeutics Receives 2026 Prix Galien USA Award for AVLAYAH® (tividenofusp alfa-eknm) as Best Biotechnology Product
raw.text: SOUTH SAN FRANCISCO, Calif., Oct. 30, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Denali Therapeutics Inc. (Nasdaq: DNLI) today announced that AVLAYAH® (tividenofusp alfa-eknm) has been recognized as the “Best Biotechnology Product” of 2026 by The Galien Foundation. AVLAYAH is the first biologic approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) that is specifically designed to cross the blood-brain barrier and reach the whole body, including the brain. AVLAYAH is an enzyme replacement therapy that received FDA accelerated approval in March 2026 for the treatment of neurologic manifestations of a rare neurodegenerative disease called Hunter syndrome (mucopolysaccharidosis type II, or MPS II) when initiated in presymptomatic or symptomatic pediatric patients weighing at least 5 kg prior to advanced neurologic impairment. Continued approval for this indication may be contingent upon verification of clinical benefit in a confirmatory study.

raw.title: New Phase 2 REC-4881 Data Presented at CGA-IGC Show Deep, Durable Polyp Burden Reductions in FAP, with Activity Across the GI Tract and in Larger, Higher-Risk Polyps
raw.text: Denver, Colorado, Nov. 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Recursion (Nasdaq: RXRX), a leading clinical-stage company pioneering AI-enabled drug discovery and development, today announced new positive Phase 2 data from the ongoing TUPELO trial of REC-4881, an investigational, oral MEK1/2 inhibitor for familial adenomatous polyposis (FAP). The new analyses show that most patients had reductions in both the number of larger, higher-risk polyps and in lower GI polyp burden, building on the upper GI results announced on October 15, 2026. Together, these findings support the potential of REC-4881 as an oral therapy to address FAP across the GI tract. Lisa Boardman, M.D., a gastroenterologist and Professor of Medicine at Mayo Clinic, presented the results in a Presidential Plenary at the Collaborative Group of the Americas on Inherited Gastrointestinal Cancer (CGA-IGC) Annual Meeting in Denver, Colorado.

raw.text: BOSTON and SAN DIEGO, Nov. 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Rapport Therapeutics, Inc. (Nasdaq: RAPP) (“Rapport” or the “Company”), a clinical-stage biotechnology company dedicated to the discovery and development of small molecule precision medicines for patients with neurological or psychiatric disorders, today announced the closing of its previously announced separate underwritten public offerings of 9,761,905 shares of its common stock, which includes the exercise in full of the underwriters' option to purchase up to 1,428,571 additional shares of its common stock, at a public offering price of $21.00 per share (the “Offering Price”) and, in lieu of common stock to investors that so choose, pre-funded warrants to purchase up to 1,190,476 shares of its common stock at an offering price of $20.999 per pre-funded warrant, which represents the per share Offering Price less the $0.001 per share exercise price for each pre-funded warrant (the “common stock offering”) and $172.5 million aggregate principal amount of 2.25% convertible senior notes due 2032 (the “notes”), which includes the exercise in full of the underwriters' over-allotment option to purchase up to an additional $22.5 million aggregate principal amount of notes (the “notes offering” and together with the common stock offering, the “underwritten offerings”). Concurrently with the underwritten offerings, Rapport entered into a securities purchase agreement with a certain investor (the “Investor”), in a separately negotiated transaction (the “concurrent private placement” and together with the underwritten offerings, the “offerings”) pursuant to which Rapport sold to the Investor 1,428,571 shares of Rapport's common stock, at the Offering Price.

(Nasdaq: RAPP) (“Rapport” or the “Company”), a clinical-stage biotechnology company dedicated to the discovery and development of small molecule precision medicines for patients with neurological or psychiatric disorders, today announced the pricing of separate underwritten public offerings of approximately $175.0 million of shares of its common stock at an offering price of $21.00 per share (the “Offering Price”) and, in lieu of common stock to investors that so choose, pre-funded warrants to purchase up to approximately $25.0 million of shares of its common stock at an offering price of $20.999 per pre-funded warrant, which represents the per share Offering Price less the $0.001 per share exercise price for each pre-funded warrant (the “common stock offering”) and $150.0 million aggregate principal amount of 2.25% convertible senior notes due 2032 (the “notes”) (the “notes offering” and together with the common stock offering, the “underwritten offerings”). Concurrently with the underwritten offerings, Rapport entered into a share purchase agreement with a certain investor (the “Investor”), in a separately negotiated transaction (the “concurrent private placement” and together with the underwritten offerings, the “offerings”) pursuant to which Rapport agreed to offer and sell, and the Investor agreed to purchase, approximately $30.0 million of shares of Rapport's common stock, at the Offering Price. The sale of shares to the Investor in the concurrent private placement will not be registered as part of the common stock offering.

raw.title: Rapport Announces Proposed Public Offerings of Common Stock and Convertible Notes as well as Concurrent Private Placement
raw.text: BOSTON and SAN DIEGO, Oct. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Rapport Therapeutics, Inc. (Nasdaq: RAPP) (“Rapport” or the “Company”), a clinical-stage biotechnology company dedicated to the discovery and development of small molecule precision medicines for patients with neurological or psychiatric disorders, today announced that it has commenced separate underwritten public offerings of $200.0 million of shares of its common stock (the “common stock offering”) and $150.0 million aggregate principal amount of convertible senior notes due 2032 (the “notes offering” and together with the common stock offering, the “underwritten offerings”). In addition, Rapport intends to grant the underwriters in the common stock offering a 30-day option to purchase up to an additional $30.0 million of shares of its common stock under the same terms and conditions and intends to grant the underwriters a 30-day option to purchase up to an additional $22.5 million aggregate principal amount of notes solely to cover over-allotments, if any. Concurrently with the underwritten offerings, Rapport intends to enter into a share purchase agreement with a certain investor named therein (the “Investor”), in a separately negotiated transaction (the “concurrent private placement” and together with the underwritten offerings, the “offerings”) pursuant to which Rapport intends to offer and sell, and the Investor intends to purchase shares of Rapport's common stock at the price per share of common stock in the common stock offering. The sale of shares to the Investor in the proposed concurrent private placement will not be registered as part of the common stock offering. The proposed offerings are subject to market and other conditions, and there can be no assurance as to whether or when the offerings may be completed, or as to the actual size or terms of the offerings.

raw.text: Capital Southwest is an internally managed BDC focused on first-lien lending to lower middle market, sponsor-backed companies. Dividend coverage is thin, with pretax NII covering nearly all but not the full dividend, relying on spillover income and equity gains to bridge the gap.

raw.text: NEREUS™ significantly reduced semaglutide induced vomiting including frequent multi-day and extreme vomiting Key Results Any vomiting (primary) 43.0% (61/142) vs 58.5% (96/164) placebo (p=0.006); 27% relative reduction Vomiting + severe nausea (key secondary): 33.1% (47/142) vs 50.6% (83/164) (p=0.002); 35% relative reduction Frequent multi-day vomiting (>2 episodes on more than one day): 6.3% (9/142) vs 15.9% (26/164) (p=0.008); 60% relative reduction Extreme vomiting (>10 total episodes): 2.8% (4/142) vs 14.6% (24/164) (p=0.0003); 81% relative reduction WASHINGTON, Oct. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Vanda Pharmaceuticals Inc. (Nasdaq: VNDA) today announced positive results from Study 3601 (VP-VLY-686-3601), a Phase III randomized, placebo-controlled study evaluating NEREUS™ (tradipitant), an oral neurokinin-1 (NK-1) receptor antagonist, for the prevention of vomiting associated with GLP-1 receptor agonist therapy. The study showed significant reduction in overall vomiting episodes (27% p=0.006 as well as reduction of frequent (60% p=0.008) and extreme vomiting (81% p=0.0003) episodes.

raw.title: Orange County Bancorp, Inc. Announces Record Third Quarter Earnings
raw.text: MIDDLETOWN, N.Y., Oct. 28, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Orange County Bancorp, Inc. (the “Company” - Nasdaq: OBT), parent company of Orange Bank & Trust Co. (the “Bank”) and Orange Investment Advisors, Inc. (“OIA”), today announced net income of $12.5 million, or $0.93 per basic and diluted share, for the three months ended September 30, 2026. This compares with net income of $10.0 million, or $0.75 per basic and diluted share, for the three months ended September 30, 2025. The increase in earnings per share, basic and diluted, was due primarily to an increase in net interest income, which included a reduction in borrowing costs due to deposit growth, and reduction in provision for credit losses, partially offset by a decrease in noninterest income, resulting from the recognition of bank owned life insurance income in the prior year period. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, net income reached $37.4 million, or $2.80 per basic and diluted share, as compared to $29.2 million, or $2.39 per basic and diluted share, for the nine months ended September 30, 2025.

raw.title: Chaince Securities, LLC to Serve as Exclusive Sales Agent for Solowin Holdings' (NASDAQ: AXG) Up to US$50 Million At-the-Market Offering Program

raw.text: CHICAGO and FORT WORTH, Texas, Oct. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Actuate Therapeutics, Inc. (NASDAQ: ACTU) (“Actuate” or the “Company”), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing novel therapies for difficult-to-treat cancers, today announced the pricing of an underwritten public offering of 30,985,900 shares of its common stock and warrants to purchase up to an aggregate of 15,492,950 shares of its common stock. The public offering price for each set of two shares of common stock and one accompanying warrant (each, a “Warrant” and collectively, the “Warrants”) to purchase one share of common stock is $0.71 per set of securities (the “Offering”). The Warrants are being sold at the rate of one Warrant for every two shares of common stock. The Warrants will have an exercise price of $0.45 per share, are exercisable immediately upon issuance and will expire five years following the date of issuance. The shares of common stock and Warrants will be issued separately but can only be purchased together in the Offering.

raw.title: Anteris Reports Medium-Size DurAVR THV Outcomes from the EMBARK Study at TCT 2026
raw.text: MINNEAPOLIS and BRISBANE, Australia, Nov. 01, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Anteris Technologies Global Corp. (“Anteris” or the “Company”) (NASDAQ: AVR, ASX: AVR) a global healthcare company committed to designing, developing, and commercializing cutting-edge medical devices to restore healthy heart function, today announced 30-day clinical and hemodynamic outcomes for the Medium-size DurAVR® Transcatheter Heart Valve (THV) in twenty-two severe aortic stenosis patients with medium aortic annuli (aortic annulus area 492 ± 38 mm2). The DurAVR THV demonstrated single digit mean gradients, large effective orifice areas (EOAs), no moderate or severe paravalvular leaks and no valve related mortality, with 100% freedom from moderate or severe prosthesis-patient mismatch* (PPM) in a cohort of medium annuli patients from the EMBARK Study.

raw.text: DALLAS, Nov. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Braemar Hotels & Resorts Inc. (NYSE: BHR) ("Braemar" or the "Company") announced today that it has successfully refinanced its mortgage loan for the 170-room Ritz-Carlton Lake Tahoe in Truckee, California, which had an existing outstanding balance of $43.4 million, a floating interest rate of SOFR + 3.25% and a final maturity date in January 2027. raw.title: Kazia Therapeutics Announces Two Abstracts on Paxalisib Tumor and Immune Reprogramming Research Accepted for Poster Presentation at 2026 San Antonio Breast Cancer Symposium
raw.text: Presentations to Explore Paxalisib's Differentiated Tumor and Immune Reprogramming Activity SYDNEY, Nov. 2, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Kazia Therapeutics Limited (NASDAQ: KZIA) ("Kazia" or the "Company"), an oncology-focused biotechnology company developing therapies that selectively reprogram cancer biology, restore anti-tumor immunity and overcome treatment resistance, today announced that two abstracts highlighting new preclinical and translational research on paxalisib's differentiated biological activity and potential application across breast cancer settings have been accepted for poster presentation at this year's San Antonio Breast Cancer Symposium ("SABCS"), taking place on Dec. 8 through 11, 2026, in San Antonio, Texas. The presentations will explore two complementary areas of research: the distinct tumor and immune reprogramming effects of paxalisib compared with other dual PI3K/mTOR inhibitors in preclinical models, and its potential to suppress local recurrence and metastatic progression when administered following standard neoadjuvant chemo-immunotherapy in a preclinical model of stage III triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC): Poster 1 (P4-9-18): "Paxalisib uniquely induces durable tumour and immune reprogramming across breast cancer subtypes, challenging the paradigm that dual PI3K/mTOR inhibitors are biologically equivalent" Poster 2 (P4-10-26): "Suppression of Local and Metastatic Recurrence by Adjuvant PI3K/mTOR Inhibition Through Durable Immune Epigenetic Rewiring Following Neoadjuvant Chemo-Immunotherapy in Stage III Triple-Negative Breast Cancer" The research further explores paxalisib's differentiated ability to reprogram tumor and immune biology in preclinical models, suggesting that these effects are not necessarily shared by other dual PI3K/mTOR inhibitors.

raw.text: Four presentations highlight BriaCell's Bria-OTS+™ cellular immunotherapy platform and BriaPro's CD80-based immunotherapy programs In vitro Bria-OTS+ studies demonstrate immune-cell activation and tumor-cell killing across breast, prostate and lung cancer models BriaPro data describes BP-80 tolerability in nonhuman primates and engineered CD80 constructs with enhanced PD-L1 binding PHILADELPHIA and VANCOUVER, British Columbia, Nov. 03, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- BriaCell Therapeutics Corp. (Nasdaq: BCTX, BCTXL) (TSX: BCT) (“BriaCell” or the “Company”), a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing novel immunotherapies to transform cancer care, and its majority-owned subsidiary, BriaPro Therapeutics Corp. (“BriaPro”), today announced four preclinical research presentations at the Society for Immunotherapy of Cancer (SITC) 41th Anniversary Annual Meeting, taking place November 4-8, 2026, in Phoenix, AZ. The presentations cover BriaCell's personalized off-the-shelf immunotherapy platform, Bria-OTS+, and three BriaPro research programs: BP-80, a soluble CD80-Fc fusion protein; TILsRx-001, a tumor-targeted CD80-based checkpoint inhibitor; and engineered CD80 variants with altered immune receptor binding.

raw.text: Sales Highlights (unaudited): Global Q1 sales AUD$2.2 million up 9% on prior comparative period (pcp) Q1 sales up 5% on prior quarter Australia Q1 sales AUD$1.8 million up 14% on prior comparative period (pcp) Q1 sales up 12% on prior quarter Canada Q1 sales AUD$0.1 million up 286% on prior comparative period (pcp) Q1 sales up 63% on prior quarter USA Q1 sales AUD$0.3 million down 19% on prior comparative period (pcp) Q1 sales down 24% on prior quarter MELBOURNE, Australia, Oct. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Immuron Limited (ASX: IMC; NASDAQ: IMRN), an Australian based and globally integrated biopharmaceutical company is pleased to announce double digit sales growth (unaudited) in the quarter ending September 30, 2026. Continued Travelan® Australian sales growth in Q1 FY27 (+14% on pcp) in Australia can be attributed to the new Travelan® brand re-launch, including new packaging and associated brand communications which has resonated strongly with consumers and has been well received and supported by all the major pharmacy banner groups.

raw.text: In vitro studies, undertaken by two leading microbiology centers, confirm RHB-204's killing capability on Mycobacterium avium subspecies paratuberculosis (MAP) and its MAP-killing comparability to RedHill's RHB-104 in both long-term intracellular culture and spot and phage assays The two sets of studies, showing confirmed MAP-killing effect and comparability to RHB-104, led by Professor Tim Bull from City St George's University of London, and Prof Irene Grant, Professor of Microbiology and Food Safety, Queen's University Belfast and Dr Hannah Dane, further support development of RHB-204's potential in MAP-related Crohn's disease  In its positive Phase 3 study, RHB-104 met the primary endpoint with statistical significance, showing RHB-104 plus standard of care (SoC) to be 64% more effective than SoC alone in treating Crohn's disease, compared to the placebo (standard of care only) group (p = 0.0048) 1  RHB-204 2 , a proprietary next-generation oral optimized formulation of RHB-104 3 , designed for reduced toxicity and side effects and enhanced patient adherence, employs a differentiated, MAP-targeted approach to the treatment of Crohn's disease  RALEIGH, N.C. and TEL AVIV, Israel, Nov. 2, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- RedHill Biopharma Ltd.

raw.title: 60 Degrees Pharmaceuticals Announces Partnership with The University of Southern Mississippi to Evaluate Castanospermine in Nonclinical Models of Alpha-Gal Syndrome
raw.text: WASHINGTON, Oct. 28, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- 60 Degrees Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (NASDAQ: SXTP; SXTPW) (the “Company”), a pharmaceutical company focused on developing new medicines for vector-borne diseases, today announced expansion of its vector-borne disease research portfolio through a sponsored research agreement with The University of Southern Mississippi (USM) to assess the therapeutic potential of castanospermine—a naturally occurring iminosugar derived from the Australian Chestnut (Castanospermum australe)—in nonclinical models of alpha-gal syndrome (AGS). The partnership leverages USM's established vector biology research expertise and investigator insights into tick-borne disease.

raw.title: 60 Degrees Pharmaceuticals Announces Clinical Improvement and Negative PCR Results in All Completed Expanded Access Babesiosis Study Patients
raw.text: All five completed patients (100%) reported much or very much improved clinical outcomes and tested negative for Babesia on conventional PCR tests Four of five completed patients (80%) were negative on highly sensitive post-treatment NAT testing Results reinforce favorable retreatment-free outcomes reported with tafenoquine–atovaquone regimens Two additional patients remain on treatment, bringing total enrollment to seven; study remains open pending potential discussions with FDA WASHINGTON, Oct. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- 60 Degrees Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (NASDAQ: SXTP; SXTPW) (“60 Degrees” or the “Company”), a pharmaceutical company focused on developing new medicines for vector-borne disease, today announced clinical and molecular results from the first five patients to complete treatment with tafenoquine-containing combination regimens in the Company's expanded access study of relapsing babesiosis in immunosuppressed patients ( NCT06478641 ). All five patients reported being much improved or very much improved on study-completion forms, and each had negative conventional polymerase chain reaction (PCR) test results for Babesia documented during treatment or subsequent follow-up.

raw.title: AbbVie Submits Biologics License Application (BLA) for Etentamig to U.S. FDA for Adults Living With Relapsed/Refractory Multiple Myeloma
raw.text: –  Etentamig is a second-generation BCMA-directed bispecific antibody T-cell engager with a clinical profile and dosing schedule that can potentially support treatment across a broad range of settings, including in community-based care –  In the Phase 3 CERVINO study, etentamig achieved statistically significant improvements in overall response rate (ORR) and progression-free survival (PFS) versus investigator's choice of standard available therapies –  Submission underscores AbbVie's ambition to advance a broad multiple myeloma portfolio that addresses disease complexity and supports patients' evolving care goals  NORTH CHICAGO, Ill., Oct. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- AbbVie (NYSE: ABBV) today announced the submission of a Biologics License Application (BLA) to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for etentamig, a second-generation BCMA x CD3 bispecific antibody T-cell engager administered intravenously for the treatment of adults with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma.1 BCMA-directed bispecific antibodies and CAR-T therapies have significantly changed the treatment landscape for people living with multiple myeloma.2 However, their broader adoption may be limited by adverse events such as cytokine release syndrome, infections or neurotoxicity, as well as specialized administration and monitoring requirements.2,3,4 Additionally, as disease relapses, treatment options in later lines of therapy become increasingly limited.

Under the Share Purchase Agreement, the Company sold all of the issued and outstanding shares of TNL Mediagene Inc., a company (Kabushiki Kaisha) duly incorporated under the laws of Japan and the holding company for Mediagene Inc. and Infobahn Inc., for aggregate consideration of $5.5 million, subject to an adjustment based on changes in net intercompany debt liabilities from a reference amount of approximately $0.6 million as of July 31, 2026 through the closing date, and to set-off, in each case as provided in the Share Purchase Agreement, with the aggregate amount of any such adjustment and set-off capped at $500,000.

raw.title: Provident Financial Services, Inc. Reports Third Quarter Earnings
raw.text: ISELIN, N.J., Oct. 28, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Provident Financial Services, Inc. (NYSE: PFS) (the “Company”) reported net income of $69.2 million, or $0.53 per basic and diluted share for the three months ended September 30, 2026, compared to $78.1 million, or $0.60 per basic and diluted share, for the three months ended June 30, 2026 and $71.7 million, or $0.55 per basic and diluted share, for the three months ended September 30, 2025. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, net income totaled $226.7 million, or $1.74 per basic and diluted share, compared to $207.7 million, or $1.59 per basic and diluted share, for the nine months ended September 30, 2025. Results for the quarter were impacted by a $17.5 million one-time loss on extinguishment of debt due to the accelerated amortization of purchase accounting adjustments, core conversion related costs of $3.7 million and $465,000 of branch restructuring expenses. Excluding these expenses, core net income (1) for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, totaled $84.3 million, or $0.65 per basic and diluted share, and $243.5 million, or $1.87 per basic and diluted share, respectively.

raw.title: BriaCell and BriaPro to Present Preclinical Anti-Cancer Activity and Immunotherapy Findings at SITC 2026
raw.text: Four presentations highlight BriaCell's Bria-OTS+™ cellular immunotherapy platform and BriaPro's CD80-based immunotherapy programs In vitro Bria-OTS+ studies demonstrate immune-cell activation and tumor-cell killing across breast, prostate and lung cancer models BriaPro data describes BP-80 tolerability in nonhuman primates and engineered CD80 constructs with enhanced PD-L1 binding PHILADELPHIA and VANCOUVER, British Columbia, Nov. 03, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- BriaCell Therapeutics Corp. (Nasdaq: BCTX, BCTXL) (TSX: BCT) (“BriaCell” or the “Company”), a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing novel immunotherapies to transform cancer care, and its majority-owned subsidiary, BriaPro Therapeutics Corp. (“BriaPro”), today announced four preclinical research presentations at the Society for Immunotherapy of Cancer (SITC) 41th Anniversary Annual Meeting, taking place November 4-8, 2026, in Phoenix, AZ. The presentations cover BriaCell's personalized off-the-shelf immunotherapy platform, Bria-OTS+, and three BriaPro research programs: BP-80, a soluble CD80-Fc fusion protein; TILsRx-001, a tumor-targeted CD80-based checkpoint inhibitor; and engineered CD80 variants with altered immune receptor binding.

raw.title: ZipRecruiter Announces Board of Directors Appointment
raw.text: SANTA MONICA, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--ZipRecruiter® (NYSE: ZIP), a leading online employment marketplace, today announced the appointment of Jeffrey Liaw to the company's Board of Directors (the “Board”) and the resignation of Emily McEvilly from her position as a member of the Board, both effective October 29, 2026. “Jeff is an accomplished operator who has scaled one of the world's leading online marketplaces, and we're excited to welcome him to our Board,” said Ian Siegel, CEO of ZipRecruit.

raw.text: ATLANTA, Oct. 30, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- A shareholder class action lawsuit has been filed against Yiren Digital Ltd.(“Yiren” or the “Company”) (NYSE: YRD). The lawsuit alleges that Defendants made false and misleading statements and/or failed to disclose material adverse facts, including allegations that: (1) CreditEase, Yiren's controlling shareholder, and its affiliates, all controlled by Defendant Tang, were experiencing severe financial distress that impaired their ability to satisfy their obligations; (2) as a result, the billions of RMB owed to Yiren by CreditEase affiliates were subject to significant credit risk; (3) Yiren was not separate from or unaffected by the affairs of CreditEase, given their shared leadership, Yiren's dependence on CreditEase, and the Company's relationships with the CreditEase affiliates whose products defaulted; (4) Defendant Tang, the Company's Executive Chairman, CEO, and controlling shareholder, was exposed to material legal and regulatory risk, including potential criminal liability, arising from CreditEase's conduct; and (5) as a result, Defendants' public statements were materially false and/or misleading at all relevant times.

raw.text: TORONTO, ONTARIO – TheNewswire - October 27, 2026 — AEON STRATEGIES LTD. (formerly Cloud3 Ventures Inc.) (CSE: AEON) (OTCQB: CLDVF) (FSE: WQ40) (the “ Company ” or “ Aeon ”) provides an update to its news release dated October 23, 2026 (the “ Default Announcement ”) regarding the anticipated late filing of its audited annual financial statements for the year ended June 30, 2026, the related management's discussion and analysis and the related CEO and CFO certifications (collectively, the “ Annual Filings ”). The Default Announcement stated that the Company expected to file the Annual Filings on or before December 4, 2026. The Auditor remains engaged, and the Company is working with the Auditor to complete the audit.

raw.title: Honey Badger Silver Announces Filing of NI 43-101 Technical Report for the PC Silver Mine Preliminary Economic Assessment
raw.text: Toronto, Ontario--(Newsfile Corp. - October 29, 2026) - Honey Badger Silver Inc. (TSXV: TUF) (OTCQB: HBEIF) (FSE: 1QA) (Tradegate: 1QA) ("Honey Badger Silver" or the "Company") is pleased to announce that it has filed an independent technical report (the "Technical Report") prepared in accordance with National Instrument 43-101 - Standards of Disclosure for Mineral Projects ("NI 43-101"), supporting the previously announced Preliminary Economic Assessment (the "PEA") and updated Mineral Resource Estimate ("MRE") for its 100%-owned PC Silver Mine (Prairie Creek) in the Northwest Territories, Canada. The Technical Report, entitled "Preliminary Economic Assessment - PC Silver Mine - Northwest Territories", with an effective date of June 21, 2026, and was prepared by JDS Energy & Mining Inc. The Technical Report is available under the Company's profile on SEDAR+ at www.sedarplus.ca and on the Company's website at www.honeybadgersilver.com.

raw.title: Happy Belly Food Group's Heal Wellness QSR Secures Real Estate Location for Multi-Unit Franchisee in Windsor, Ontario
raw.text: Toronto, Ontario--(Newsfile Corp. - November 3, 2026) - Happy Belly Food Group Inc. (CSE: HBFG) (OTCQB: HBFGF) ("Happy Belly" or the "Company"), a leading consolidator of emerging restaurant brands, is pleased to announce that its Heal Wellness brand ("Heal") has secured a new real-estate location in Windsor, Ontario, for the multi-unit franchise group led by Alex Rechichi and Bedford Park Capital. The location was secured as part of Heal's Multi-Unit Franchise Agreement for 45 locations across Ontario, Manitoba, and Saskatchewan.

raw.title: Happy Belly Food Group's Heal Wellness Signs Binding Agreement for 150 Heal Wellness Franchise Units Across the State of Texas, USA
raw.text: Toronto, Ontario--(Newsfile Corp. - November 2, 2026) - Happy Belly Food Group Inc. (CSE: HBFG) (OTCQB: HBFGF) ("Happy Belly" or the "Company"), a leading consolidator of emerging restaurant brands, is pleased to announce its largest franchise development agreement in company history, with the signing of a binding 150 Heal Wellness restaurants ("Heal") in the State of Texas with our existing multi-unit operator, The Curative Group. Heal is a quick-service restaurant ("QSR") brand specializing in fresh smoothie bowls, açaí bowls, and smoothies.

raw.title: Happy Belly Food Group Announces the Grand Opening of Yolks Breakfast in Vaughan, Ontario
raw.text: Toronto, Ontario--(Newsfile Corp. - October 30, 2026) - Happy Belly Food Group Inc. (CSE: HBFG) (OTCQB: HBFGF) ("Happy Belly" or the "Company"), a leading consolidator of emerging restaurant brands, is pleased to announce that its newest Yolks Breakfast ("Yolks") restaurant will begin welcoming guests for its soft opening on Friday, October 30th, 2026, at Woodbridge Square, 7600 Weston Road, Vaughan, Ontario, with the official grand opening scheduled for Friday, November 13, 2026. The new franchised location reinforces the Company's asset-light growth strategy as Yolks continues to expand its presence across Canada.

So if London is up 10%, the other listings will usually catch up. If the OTC or German price moves on low volume while London is closed, I don't read much into it.

Bottom line: Watch HE1 i

recentNews.title: Edgewater Wireless Announces Payments of Debenture Interest

raw.title: Edgewater Wireless Announces Payments of Debenture Interest
raw.text: October 30, 2026 – TheNewswire - Ottawa, Canada – Edgewater Wireless Systems Inc. (TSXV: YFI) (OTC: KPIFF) (“ Edgewater ” or the “ Company ”) announces that it will settle its obligation to pay an aggregate of $17,726.30 in interest as of December 1, 2025, $17,531.51 in interest as of March 1, 2026, $17,921.10 in interest as of June 1, 2026 and $17,921.10 in interest as of September 1, 2026 to the holders of its unsecured debentures issued September 1, 2022 (the “ Debentures ”) through the issuance of an aggregate of 1,421,982 common shares of the Company at a deemed price of $0.05 per share (the “ Shares ”). The Shares are issued in full satisfaction of the December 1, 2025, March 1, 2026, June 1, 2026 and September 1, 2026 interest payment obligations in accordance with the terms of the Debentures. The debt settlement is subject to the approval of the TSX Venture Exchange.   Certain directors of the Company received an aggregate of 265,995 Shares and therefore the share issuance constitutes a “related party transaction” as that term is defined in Multilateral Instrument 61-101 - Protection of Minority Security Holders in Special Transactions (“ MI 61-101 ”). The Company will rely on the exemptions from the formal valuation and minority shareholder approval requirements of MI 61-101 contained in sections 5.5(a) and 5.7(1)(a) of MI 61-101 as neither the fair market value of the Shares nor the debt exceeds 25% of the Company's market capitalization .

NAM is committed to working collaboratively with local First Nations to ensure responsible, sustainable exploration that respects community values and priorities.

raw.text: HIGHLIGHTS Novo has now received all regulatory and land holder approvals required to commence a ~2,700 m RC program at Tibooburra, NSW, with drilling at the Clone prospect currently anticipated to commence in early-November 2026.  Step out drilling at the Clone prospect will target a northern extension to open, shallowly plunging, high-grade gold mineralisation confirmed during Novo's 2025 drill campaign that reported results up to 12 m @ 5.90 g/t Au from 16 m, including 5 m @ 13.74 g/t Au from 23 m in TBR0001.1   Regional streams and targeted soils, mapping and rock chip sampling commenced at Tibooburra in September 2026, with results pending and a further program being undertaken in October 2026.

raw.title: Pinnacle Prepares Plans for Drilling and Field Work to Follow Up on Polymetallic Discoveries at El Potrero
raw.text: VANCOUVER, BRITISH COLUMBIA, October 29, 2026 – TheNewswire - (TSXV: PINN, OTCQB: PSGCF, Frankfurt: P9J) – Pinnacle Silver and Gold Corp. (" Pinnacle " or the “ Company ") is pleased to announce that its geological team has put together a diamond drilling program to follow up on the silver-gold-lead-zinc mineralization discovered on the Maria Fernanda 2 (“MF2”) concession on the Potrero project in Durango, Mexico earlier this year (see Figures 1 and 2).  While permitting is underway on this drill program, detailed mapping and sampling will be conducted on the northern El Potrero claim block following up on the discovery of silver-rich veins with assays up to 1,159 g/t Ag (see Pinnacle news releases from March 17 and April 20, 2026 ) .   “The exciting discovery of high-grade gold-silver-lead-zinc mineralization earlier this year demonstrated the district scale potential of the Potrero Project ,” stated Robert Archer, Pinnacle's President & CEO.  “Having conducted extensive mapping and sampling on the MF2 concession, we now believe that this polymetallic mineralization is an extension of the Topia Mine system, only four kilometres to the southwest.  The polymetallic veins have a northeasterly trend, as at Topia, as opposed to the dominantly northwesterly trend of the gold-silver veins in the northern part of the Potrero property, and are believed to represent a completely different age of hydrothermal activity 1 .  The alteration, vein textures and elevation all point to the potential for the preservation of significant mineralization not far below surface at MF2.  The Phase I drill program will test this concept and, if successful, will lead to a larger drilling campaign of delineation drilling.  In addition, we look forward to following up on similar, silver-rich veins on the southern part of the Potrero block, roughly five kilometres from the MF2 mineralization.”

raw.title: Sirios Resources Inc. Announces Results of Shareholder Meeting
raw.text: Montréal, Québec--(Newsfile Corp. - October 30, 2026) - Sirios Resources Inc. (TSXV: SOI) (OTCQB: SIREF) (FSE: 377A) ("Sirios" or "Company") is pleased to announce the voting results for its annual general and special meeting of shareholders held earlier today at 900, boulevard De Maisonneuve Ouest, Suite 1800, Montréal, Québec, H3A 0A8 (the "Meeting"). Shareholders voted in favour of all matters brought before the Meeting and all resolutions were duly passed, including: (i) the election of each of the seven nominated directors, being Dominique Doucet, Jean-Félix Lepage, Colinda Parent, Guy Le Bel, Robert Ménard, Sean Roosen, and Laurence Farmer; (ii) the reappointment of Raymond Chabot Grant Thornton LLP as the independent auditor of the Company for the ensuing year and the authorization for the board of directors to fix its remuneration; (iii) a special resolution authorizing the change of name of the Company from "Sirios Resources Inc." to "Sirios Mining Inc." and, in French, "Minière Sirios Inc." ("Name Change"); (iv) a special resolution authorizing a share consolidation on the basis of one (1) post-consolidation common share for every fifteen (15) pre-consolidation common shares ("Consolidation"); and (v) the Company's new 10% "rolling" omnibus equity incentive plan ("Omnibus Plan"), which provides for the grant of options, share units, and deferred share units.

raw.title: San Lorenzo Files Second Amended and Restated Offering Document

raw.title: Spark Defines a 21 km2 Rare Earth Target at Boa Vista, Nearly Three Times the Cruzeta Footprint and Anchored by Drilling
raw.text: Catchment analysis joins the anomalous drainages of Boa Vista into one target of 21.3 km² along a 13 km trend, wrapped around the five mineralized maiden holes; new sample ARA-SS-394 returns 4,356 ppm TREO; RC drilling starts beside the maiden holes Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - November 3, 2026) - Spark Energy Minerals Inc. (CSE: SPRK) (OTC Pink: SPARF) (FSE: 8PC) ("Spark" or the "Company") reports the complete stream-sediment and rock-chip dataset of the Boa Vista area, within its 100% owned Arapaima Project in Minas Gerais, Brazil, with 37 samples reported for the first time, and the catchment analysis that turns the dataset into one target of 21.3 km², around the holes that have already intersected the rare earth zone, with a drilling program sized to it. Highlights A 21.3 km² target, 13 km long.

raw.title: Spark Intersects 52 m at 1,906 ppm TREO from Surface at Cruzeta

(CSE: SPRK) (OTC Pink: SPARF) (FSE: 8PC) ("Spark" or the "Company") reports assay results from nine reverse circulation ("RC") drill holes at its 100% owned Arapaima Project in Minas Gerais, Brazil: eight holes at the Cruzeta target (ARA-RC-035 to ARA-RC-042) and ARA-RC-032, the first hole reported from the Domingos Gonçalves target. At Cruzeta, 282 m of the 362 m drilled (78%) fall within main intervals grading 500 ppm total rare earth oxides ("TREO") or more.

raw.text: Tencent (TCEHY) is rated HOLD as I see a structural mismatch between heavy AI capex and limited near-term revenue visibility. AI investments are driving significant capex and negative FCF, with Q2 2026 capex up 176% y/y to RMB 53bn and a RMB 14bn FCF deficit. AI benefits are mostly cost optimization and advertising eCPM gains, but gaming and fintech lack material AI-driven revenue growth.

raw.title: Wesdome Expands High-Grade Zones at Eagle River, Highlighting Growth Potential near Existing Infrastructure
raw.text: High-grade growth potential laterally and at depth: Drilling in the western extension of the 800 Zone, one of the mineralized zones at Eagle River, intersected high-grade gold over significant widths, including 8.3 g/t gold over 10.6 metres, highlighting the potential to expand the known high-grade zone laterally. Previously released drilling also identified mineralization more than 200 metres below the current zone model, outlining a prospective corridor for further expansion at depth.

raw.title: Wesdome: The Q3 Production Miss Took Away The Premium, Not The Value
raw.text: Q3 production of 41,287 ounces was missed as Kiena lost 10 days to maintenance and blended in early Presqu'ile ore; Eagle River milled a record 79,820 tonnes. 2026 is expected below the 192,500-ounce midpoint, so Q4 needs about 49,600 ounces just to reach the guide floor. At C$28.00, the shares trade at 0.93x my US$21.57 risked NAV, against a 0.96x peer median: the fall removed a premium rather than opening a discount.

raw.title: Westward Gold Announces Appointment of Mr. Andrew Lee to Board of Directors
raw.text: Vancouver, British Columbia, October 28, 2026 - TheNewswire – Westward Gold Inc. (CSE: WG, OTCQB: WGLIF, FSE: IM50) (“Westward” or the “Company”) is pleased to announce the appointment of Mr. Andrew Lee to the Company's Board of Directors, effective October 28, 2026. Mr. Lee will serve as Independent Director, replacing Mr. Allan Fabbro, who has acted in that role since June of 2023. Mr. Lee brings over 15 years of experience in mining finance, capital markets and strategy to Westward. He currently serves as Vice President, Finance at Wheaton Precious Metals Corp. (“Wheaton”), where he oversees corporate finance and treasury, and plays a key role in evaluating, structuring and executing streaming and royalty transactions and strategic investments. Prior to joining Wheaton in 2017, Mr. Lee held various positions at BHP Group in Singapore, focusing on global commodity markets and corporate strategy. He also serves as a director of Pacific Empire Minerals Corp. Mr. Lee holds a Master of Business Administration from Simon Fraser University and a Bachelor of Science (Honours) in Mathematics and Economics from Nanyang Technological University in Singapore.

raw.title: RecycLiCo and Alaska Energy Metals Collaborate to Test Proprietary Processing Methods on the Polymetallic Eureka Deposit, Nikolai Nickel Project, Alaska
raw.text: VANCOUVER, British Columbia, Oct. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- RecycLiCo Battery Materials Inc. (“RecycLiCo”) (TSX.V: AMY | OTCQB: AMYZF | FSE: ID4), a critical mineral refining and lithium-ion battery upcycling company, and Alaska Energy Metals Corp. (“AEMC”) (TSX.V: AEMC | OTCQB: AKEMF | FRA: V7F) are pleased to announce the commencement of testing of metal concentrate samples derived from drill core from the 2023-2024 exploration campaigns at the polymetallic Eureka deposit, located at AEMC's Nikolai Nickel Project in Alaska. The work is being done at RecycLiCo's laboratory in Delta, BC, in accordance with a protocol prepared by RecycLiCo and approved by AEMC. Testing is in furtherance of the previously announced memorandum of understanding (“MOU”) between AEMC and RecycLiCo's U.S. subsidiary to assess the ways in which RecycLiCo's hydrometallurgical processing technology could be used in refining the output from the Eureka deposit, which contains seven U.S. Government-designated Critical Minerals, including nickel, cobalt, copper, chromium, platinum, palladium, and gold (along with the non-critical mainstay metal iron). Recently reported locked cycle flotation results have proven strong recoveries of metals reporting to a bulk nickel-copper concentrate. raw.title: RecycLiCo and Alaska Energy Metals Collaborate to Test Proprietary Processing Methods on the Polymetallic Eureka Deposit, Nikolai Nickel Project, Alaska
raw.text: VANCOUVER, British Columbia, Oct. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- RecycLiCo Battery Materials Inc. (“RecycLiCo”) (TSX.V: AMY | OTCQB: AMYZF | FSE: ID4), a critical mineral refining and lithium-ion battery upcycling company, and Alaska Energy Metals Corp. (“AEMC”) (TSX.V: AEMC | OTCQB: AKEMF | FRA: V7F) are pleased to announce the commencement of testing of metal concentrate samples derived from drill core from the 2023-2024 exploration campaigns at the polymetallic Eureka deposit, located at AEMC's Nikolai Nickel Project in Alaska. The work is being done at RecycLiCo's laboratory in Delta, BC, in accordance with a protocol prepared by RecycLiCo and approved by AEMC. Testing is in furtherance of the previously announced memorandum of understanding (“MOU”) between AEMC and RecycLiCo's U.S. subsidiary to assess the ways in which RecycLiCo's hydrometallurgical processing technology could be used in refining the output from the Eureka deposit, which contains seven U.S. Government-designated Critical Minerals, including nickel, cobalt, copper, chromium, platinum, palladium, and gold (along with the non-critical mainstay metal iron). Recently reported locked cycle flotation results have proven strong recoveries of metals reporting to a bulk nickel-copper concentrate. AEMC is exploring multiple avenues for hydrometallurgical testing to determine the optimum extraction technique to achieve the highest value from downstream processing of the bulk concentrate.

raw.title: Conavi Medical Presents Data Demonstrating Feasibility of Saline-Based Hybrid IVUS–OCT Imaging with OCTIV™ at TCT 2026
raw.text: TORONTO, Nov. 03, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Conavi Medical Corp. (TSXV: CNVI) (OTCQB: CNVIF) ("Conavi" or the "Company"), a commercial-stage medical device company developing imaging technologies to guide cardiovascular procedures, today announced the presentation of data from its OCTIV™ hybrid IVUS–OCT imaging system at Transcatheter Cardiovascular Therapeutics (“TCT”) 2026. The study, conducted in an animal model before OCTIV's use in patients, demonstrated the feasibility of using saline instead of iodinated contrast during image acquisition. The FDA-cleared system is now in commercial clinical use, with its first U.S. placement completed and patient cases ongoing. The findings were presented by Megha Prasad, MD, MS, in an abstract titled "Saline-Based Hybrid IVUS-OCT Imaging: Feasibility of Contrast-Free Dual-Modality Intracoronary Imaging in a Porcine Model."

Interventional cardiologist Dr. Megha Prasad performed the first cases, marking a milestone in Conavi's U.S. commercial rollout.

raw.title: Doubleview Announces $3.2 Million Flow-Through Private Placement
raw.text: Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - November 2, 2026) - Doubleview Gold Corp. (TSXV: DBG) (OTCQX: DBLVF) (WKN: A1W038) (the "Company or "Doubleview") announces that it intends to complete a non-brokered flow-through private placement financing (the "Offering") to raise gross proceeds of up to $3,200,000 through the issuance of up to 1,454,545 flow-through units (the "FT Units") at a price of $2.20 per FT Unit.
